title: Crystal Canyon Biome
description: Subterranean canyon biome filled with glowing crystals, rare mineral veins, and dangerous subterranean bosses.
author: Aetheria World Gen Team
behaviorBullets: Generates below Y: 0 in Mountainous regions
Contains glowing crystal clusters that emit light level 12
High concentration of diamond and raw crystal ore veins

sections.title: Biome Overview & Exploration
sections.content: The **Crystal Canyon** is a breathtaking subterranean biome where players can harvest rare crystals and encounter elite bosses.
